s.note: the fruit stall where Anakin buys a pallie for old Jira
s.how: Slice 2 pears and 3 nectarines thinly and fan out on a big board. Drizzle with honey, then scatter with crumbled feta and roughly chopped toasted pistachios. Serve straight away like a market stall spread in the desert heat.

Cut 600g lamb leg into cubes and marinate in yoghurt, cumin, crushed garlic and salt for an hour. Thread onto skewers and grill hot and fast for 6 minutes, turning. Whisk tahini with lemon juice and water until smooth and drizzle over to serve.

m.note: Shmi cooking for the Jedi in her small home
m.how: Rub 1kg chicken thighs with harissa, lemon juice and salt. Spread 2 cans of drained chickpeas and 2 sliced red onions in a tray and sit the chicken on top. Roast at 200C for 40 minutes. Serve with warm flatbread and cucumber yoghurt.

w.n: Duel of the Fates red and blue tart
w.note: the double-bladed red lightsaber against the Jedi
w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case and cool. Fill with 500ml thick vanilla custard. Cover one half with raspberries and the other half with blueberries, meeting in a clean line down the middle. Brush with warm apricot jam to glaze and chill.

d.how: Blend 750ml cold milk with 250ml coconut milk, 2 tbsp honey and a big handful of ice until frothy. Add a few drops of blue food colouring and blend again until evenly pale blue. Pour into glasses and serve icy cold.
